keys: Map loads when you press Start.
en: Map loads when you press Start.

keys: You are out of bed. Move, gather wood or tend a fire; outside exposure continues. Return to your bed and press [N] to sleep.
en: You are out of bed. Move, gather wood or tend a fire; outside exposure continues. Return to your bed and press [N] to sleep.
zh: 已起床。现在可以移动、采柴或照料火堆；暴露在外仍会失温。回到铺位后按 [N] 再睡。

keys: Night has fallen. You can still move and gather; exposed ground is colder. Enter your shelter before choosing to sleep.
en: Night has fallen. You can still move and gather; exposed ground is colder. Enter your shelter before choosing to sleep.
zh: 天黑了。仍可移动和采集；露天失温更快。进入庇护所后再选择睡眠。

keys: Snow shelter: no indoor fire. The outside fire warms you only when you go out to its heat circle; it does not block cold air at the entrance. Get out of bed to tend it or gather wood.
en: Snow shelter: no indoor fire. The outside fire warms you only when you go out to its heat circle; it does not block cold air at the entrance. Get out of bed to tend it or gather wood.
zh: 雪屋内不能生火。门外火堆不是挡风墙；需起床走到取暖圈内，才能取暖或添柴，也可以外出采柴。

keys: Tent: fuel goes into the chimney stove inside.
en: Tent: fuel goes into the chimney stove inside.
zh: 帐篷：添柴给室内连接烟囱的火炉。

keys: Open shelter: fuel goes into the fire at the opening. Get out of bed to move around or gather more wood.
en: Open shelter: fuel goes into the fire at the opening. Get out of bed to move around or gather more wood.
zh: 开放式庇护所：添柴给开口处的火堆。需采柴或走动时，先起床返回自由行动。

keys: Get out of bed: move, tend a fire or gather wood (exposure continues)
en: Get out of bed: move, tend a fire or gather wood (exposure continues)
zh: 起床：移动、添柴或采集（暴露仍会失温）

keys: awake in the world; exposure continued
en: awake in the world; exposure continued
zh: 自由行动，持续计算暴露

keys: No shelter — exposed to the %d km/h wind all night.
en: No shelter — exposed to the %d km/h wind all night.
zh: 没有庇护所，需要整夜承受 %d km/h 的风。

keys: The tent door faced into the wind (%d°): the fabric flapped and drafts cut through all night.
en: The tent door faced into the wind (%d°): the fabric flapped and drafts cut through all night.
zh: 帐篷门迎风（%d°），风容易灌入。

keys: The tent door was side-on to the wind (%d°); gusts pressed the fabric in now and then.
en: The tent door was side-on to the wind (%d°); gusts pressed the fabric in now and then.
zh: 帐篷门侧对来风（%d°），阵风容易影响帐篷。

keys: The tent door was leeward (%d°); the fabric blocked the worst of the wind.
en: The tent door was leeward (%d°); the fabric blocked the worst of the wind.
zh: 帐篷门背风（%d°），帐篷减少了风的影响。

keys: The entrance faced into the wind (%d°): drafts and drifting snow all night.
en: The entrance faced into the wind (%d°): drafts and drifting snow all night.
zh: 入口迎风（%d°），容易灌风、飘入积雪。

keys: The entrance was side-on to the wind (%d°); gusts cut in now and then.
en: The entrance was side-on to the wind (%d°); gusts cut in now and then.
zh: 入口侧对来风（%d°），阵风仍可能灌入。

keys: The entrance was leeward (%d°); the wind passed over you.
en: The entrance was leeward (%d°); the wind passed over you.
zh: 入口背风（%d°），减少了风直接灌入。

keys: Only %d%% of the tent was up — the door or pegging was unfinished.
en: Only %d%% of the tent was up — the door or pegging was unfinished.
zh: 帐篷只完成 %d%%，门帘或固定尚未完成。

keys: Tent pitched, pegged and sealed; canvas has no snow body or reflector wall to hold heat.
en: Tent pitched, pegged and sealed; canvas has no snow body or reflector wall to hold heat.
zh: 帐篷已搭好并固定，但帆布不像雪墙那样保温，也没有反射火墙。

keys: The snow here (%.1f m) was too shallow for this shelter.
en: The snow here (%.1f m) was too shallow for this shelter.
zh: 此处雪深 %.1f 米，不足以建这种庇护所。

keys: Only %d%% finished — it wasn't closed up before night.
en: Only %d%% finished — it wasn't closed up before night.
zh: 只完成 %d%%，入夜前尚未封好。

keys: The spruce's own boughs made the roof; %.1f m of snow around the trunk made the walls.
en: The spruce's own boughs made the roof; %.1f m of snow around the trunk made the walls.
zh: 云杉枝条作为屋顶，树干周围 %.1f 米的雪形成围壁。

keys: Roof thickness %.2f m; snow depth %.1f m. Structure score includes completion and depth.
en: Roof thickness %.2f m; snow depth %.1f m. Structure score includes completion and depth.
zh: 顶厚 %.2f 米，雪深 %.1f 米；结构分同时考虑完工度与雪深。

keys: The frame and roof were finished. Fire reflection depends on the shelter type.
en: The frame and roof were finished. Fire reflection depends on the shelter type.
zh: 骨架与屋顶已完工；是否能反射火的热量取决于庇护所类型。

keys: No bedding: you lay on the snow and it drew the heat out of you.
en: No bedding: you lay on the snow and it drew the heat out of you.
zh: 没有垫层，身体向雪面快速散热。

keys: Thick bough and grass bedding reduced heat loss into the snow.
en: Thick bough and grass bedding reduced heat loss into the snow.
zh: 厚实的枝条与干草垫层减少了向雪面的散热。

keys: Thin bedding — the cold crept up by morning.
en: Thin bedding — the cold crept up by morning.
zh: 垫层较薄，向地面的散热较多。

keys: An open shelter loses warm air; thick bedding and an external fire reduce heat loss.
en: An open shelter loses warm air; thick bedding and an external fire reduce heat loss.
zh: 开放式庇护所难以留住暖空气；厚垫层与外部火源可减少失温。

keys: No cold-air pit: the grass bed and sleeping bag kept you off the ground, but the tent floor still conducts cold.
en: No cold-air pit: the grass bed and sleeping bag kept you off the ground, but the tent floor still conducts cold.
zh: 没有冷气槽；干草垫层和睡袋减少了与地面的热交换，但地布仍会传热。

keys: No raised sleeping platform separates the bed from cold air near the ground.
en: No raised sleeping platform separates the bed from cold air near the ground.
zh: 没有高床让铺位避开近地面的较冷空气。

keys: You slept at the bottom of the well with the cold air; a thick bough floor is what kept it off you.
en: You slept at the bottom of the well with the cold air; a thick bough floor is what kept it off you.
zh: 树井铺位低于周围雪面；厚枝条垫层可减少散热。

keys: The sleeping platform is above the low passage and cold-air sump.
en: The sleeping platform is above the low passage and cold-air sump.
zh: 睡台高于低位入口通道和冷气槽，较冷空气主要停留在睡台下方。

keys: A cold-air pit, but the bed wasn't raised — cold air still reached you.
en: A cold-air pit, but the bed wasn't raised — cold air still reached you.
zh: 有冷气槽，但睡台未抬高，较冷空气仍容易接触铺位。

keys: The sleeping floor is level with the entrance passage. This design has no raised platform; colder air can reach the bedding.
en: The sleeping floor is level with the entrance passage. This design has no raised platform; colder air can reach the bedding.
zh: 睡面与入口通道同高，没有高床隔离；较冷空气容易接触铺位。这是结构局限，并非漏做施工。

keys: The chimney and ventilation openings must stay clear; ventilation also carries heat away.
en: The chimney and ventilation openings must stay clear; ventilation also carries heat away.
zh: 烟囱与换气通道必须畅通；换气也会带走一部分热量。

keys: This bough roof is treated as ventilated in the game; it has no snow-vent blockage event.
en: This bough roof is treated as ventilated in the game; it has no snow-vent blockage event.
zh: 游戏按开放通风的枝条屋顶计算，不触发雪屋通气孔堵塞事件。

keys: The open structure is treated as ventilated; it also loses warm air.
en: The open structure is treated as ventilated; it also loses warm air.
zh: 游戏按开放通风结构计算，同时暖空气也容易散失。

keys: No vent: CO₂ and moisture built up inside. Dangerous.
en: No vent: CO₂ and moisture built up inside. Dangerous.
zh: 没有通气孔，密闭空间换气不足，存在窒息危险。

keys: Snow can partly block this vent. Clear it if a blockage event occurs.
en: Snow can partly block this vent. Clear it if a blockage event occurs.
zh: 降雪可能堵塞此通气孔；出现堵孔事件时请清理。

keys: The vent kept the air fresh.
en: The vent kept the air fresh.

keys: No fire in the pan: the tent only broke the wind, so you kept losing heat all night.
en: No fire in the pan: the tent only broke the wind, so you kept losing heat all night.
zh: 火炉未点燃；帐篷主要挡风，仍会持续失温。

keys: The stove has a theoretical fuel budget of %.0f hours; while burning, it slows heat loss in the tent.
en: The stove has a theoretical fuel budget of %.0f hours; while burning, it slows heat loss in the tent.
zh: 火炉的理论燃料预算为 %.0f 小时；有火能减缓帐篷内的失温。

keys: The fire pan ran out around %s; without that small heat the tent cooled for the rest of the night.
en: The fire pan ran out around %s; without that small heat the tent cooled for the rest of the night.
zh: 火炉的理论燃料预算约在 %s 耗尽；此后失去这部分供热。

keys: Snow depth %.1f m contributes to insulation. No fire burns inside this snow shelter.
en: Snow depth %.1f m contributes to insulation. No fire burns inside this snow shelter.
zh: 雪深 %.1f 米，有助于保温；这种雪屋内不生火。

keys: Only %.1f m of snow: thin walls let the heat leak out. Deeper snow (2.4 m+) means a warmer night.
en: Only %.1f m of snow: thin walls let the heat leak out. Deeper snow (2.4 m+) means a warmer night.
zh: 雪深只有 %.1f 米，雪墙保温有限；更深的雪通常提供更大的保温余量。

keys: A fire and hot water before bed helped.
en: A fire and hot water before bed helped.
zh: 睡前烤火和热饮改善了入睡状态。

keys: A fire and a hot drink before bed would have helped.
en: A fire and a hot drink before bed would have helped.
zh: 睡前烤火和热饮有助于改善入睡状态。

keys: No fire in an open lean-to: a long, bitter night.
en: No fire in an open lean-to: a long, bitter night.
zh: 开放式棚屋没有火源，夜间更容易失温。

keys: The reflector fire has a theoretical fuel budget of %.0f hours.
en: The reflector fire has a theoretical fuel budget of %.0f hours.
zh: 反射火的理论燃料预算为 %.0f 小时。

keys: The wood ran out around %s; the rest of the night was bitter.
en: The wood ran out around %s; the rest of the night was bitter.
zh: 理论燃料预算约在 %s 耗尽，之后更容易失温。
没有庇护结构帮助保温。

keys: Your clothes were wet at bedtime, reducing their insulation.
en: Your clothes were wet at bedtime, reducing their insulation.
zh: 入睡时衣物湿透，保温效果降低。

keys: Your clothes were damp at bedtime, which cost you some warmth.
en: Your clothes were damp at bedtime, which cost you some warmth.
zh: 入睡时衣物受潮，增加了散热。

keys: You went to bed already chilled (%d/100).
en: You went to bed already chilled (%d/100).
zh: 入睡时已经受冷（保暖值 %d/100）。

keys: 1. Clear the ground and lay a grass bed
en: 1. Clear the ground and lay a grass bed

keys: 2. Pitch the tent and peg the windward side
en: 2. Pitch the tent and peg the windward side

keys: 3. Set the small fire pan and chimney
en: 3. Set the small fire pan and chimney

keys: 5. Seal the door and stack firewood inside
en: 5. Seal the door and stack firewood inside
zh: 5. 压好门帘，在帐篷内堆柴

keys: The fire is outside. It cannot heat this enclosed snow shelter; dry off before bed.
en: The fire is outside. It cannot heat this enclosed snow shelter; dry off before bed.
zh: 火在洞外，不能给封闭雪屋内供暖；请在睡前烘干衣服。

keys: Stoke the tent stove: %d logs, +%d min (%d left)
en: Stoke the tent stove: %d logs, +%d min (%d left)
zh: 帐篷火炉：添 %d 根柴，续燃 %d 分钟（剩 %d 根）

keys: Tend the fire at the opening: %d logs, +%d min (%d left)
en: Tend the fire at the opening: %d logs, +%d min (%d left)
zh: 照料开口旁的火：添 %d 根柴，续燃 %d 分钟（剩 %d 根）

keys: Move in your bedding (+%d warmth net, 10 min; costs sleep)
en: Move in your bedding (+%d warmth net, 10 min; costs sleep)
zh: 在铺位活动（净回温 %d，耗时 10 分钟，损失睡眠）
通气孔 · 洞内禁止生火

keys: Body warmth %d. Awake by choice, before the cold wakes you: check your shelter and bedding, then sleep again. Every wake costs sleep.
en: Body warmth %d. Awake by choice, before the cold wakes you: check your shelter and bedding, then sleep again. Every wake costs sleep.
zh: 保暖值 %d。主动醒来：检查庇护所和铺位，再继续睡。每次醒来都会损失睡眠。

keys: Tent kit ON — slower, no firewood on your back
en: Tent kit ON — slower, no firewood on your back
zh: [T] 帐篷套装 已开——走得慢，背上不能带柴

keys: Tent kit OFF — standard shovel kit
en: Tent kit OFF — standard shovel kit
zh: [T] 帐篷套装 关——标准雪铲装备

keys: [T] Tent kit ON — slower, no firewood on your back
en: [T] Tent kit ON — slower, no firewood on your back
zh: [T] 帐篷套装 开——走得慢，背上不能带柴

keys: [T] Tent kit OFF — standard shovel kit
en: [T] Tent kit OFF — standard shovel kit
zh: [T] 帐篷套装 关——标准雪铲装备

keys: Tent kit: no shovel, no firewood on the back, slower; pitch it to carry wood.
en: Tent kit: no shovel, no firewood on the back, slower; pitch it to carry wood.
zh: 帐篷套装：不带雪铲，背上不能带柴，走得更慢；支起帐篷后就能背柴。

keys: Tent on your back — no firewood, slower. Pitch it before you gather wood.
en: Tent on your back — no firewood, slower. Pitch it before you gather wood.
zh: 帐篷还背在背上——不能带柴、走得慢。先把帐篷支起来再拾柴。

keys: Tent is up. You can carry wood now — stack it inside for the fire pan.
en: Tent is up. You can carry wood now — stack it inside for the fire pan.
zh: 帐篷支好了。现在可以背柴了——把柴堆到帐篷里给火盆用。

keys: Too steep for a tent (%d° > %d°): find flatter ground
en: Too steep for a tent (%d° > %d°): find flatter ground
zh: 太陡，搭不了帐篷（%d° > %d°）：找平一点的地方
小火盆 + 烟囱（不带雪铲）

keys: A tent loses heat through the canvas and floor. To keep the fire pan alive for %.0f h you need about %d logs inside; stack them during the day.
en: A tent loses heat through the canvas and floor. To keep the fire pan alive for %.0f h you need about %d logs inside; stack them during the day.
zh: 帐篷会从帆布和地布持续散热。要让火盆烧 %.0f 小时，帐篷里大约需要 %d 根柴；白天就要把柴堆进去。

keys: Lay the grass bed and sleep in the bag: a tent alone is only windbreak, not warmth.
en: Lay the grass bed and sleep in the bag: a tent alone is only windbreak, not warmth.
zh: 先铺干草垫层再睡进睡袋：帐篷只挡风，本身不保暖。

keys: Finish pegging and sealing the tent before dark; an unfinished tent is just fabric in the wind.
en: Finish pegging and sealing the tent before dark; an unfinished tent is just fabric in the wind.
zh: 天黑前把地钉和门帘都压好；没搭完的帐篷只是风里的一块布。

keys: Stage 1: Clear the ground and lay a grass bed
en: Stage 1: Clear the ground and lay a grass bed

keys: Stage 2: Pitch the tent and peg the windward side
en: Stage 2: Pitch the tent and peg the windward side
zh: 阶段 2：支帐篷、压好迎风边

keys: Stage 3: Set the small fire pan and chimney
en: Stage 3: Set the small fire pan and chimney

keys: Stage 4: Roll out the sleeping bag
en: Stage 4: Roll out the sleeping bag

keys: Stage 5: Seal the door and stack firewood inside
en: Stage 5: Seal the door and stack firewood inside
zh: 阶段 5：压好门帘、把柴堆进帐篷

keys: Please rotate your phone to landscape
en: Please rotate your phone to landscape

keys: DejaVu Sans symbols font © Bitstream and DejaVu authors, free license (assets/fonts/DejaVuSans-LICENSE.txt).
en: DejaVu Sans symbols font © Bitstream and DejaVu authors, free license (assets/fonts/DejaVuSans-LICENSE.txt).
zh: 符号字体 DejaVu Sans © Bitstream 与 DejaVu 作者，自由许可（assets/fonts/DejaVuSans-LICENSE.txt）。
约 %.1f m · 只能搭倒棚

keys: No open fire inside a snow shelter — it melts the roof and fills it with CO.
en: No open fire inside a snow shelter — it melts the roof and fills it with CO.
zh: 雪庇护所里不能生明火——会烤化顶棚，还会积聚一氧化碳。

keys: Need %d dry wood. Standing dead trees burn; fallen logs are wet.
en: Need %d dry wood. Standing dead trees burn; fallen logs are wet.
zh: 需要 %d 根干柴。立枯木能烧，倒木是湿的。

keys: Fire put out by snow falling from the branches above. Move out from under the tree.
en: Fire put out by snow falling from the branches above. Move out from under the tree.
zh: 树枝上的积雪落下，把火压灭了。离开树冠下方再生火。

keys: Striking the ferro rod… keep holding [F]
en: Striking the ferro rod… keep holding [F]
zh: 擦打火棒……按住 [F] 别松

keys: Fire lit. Warm up, dry off, and melt snow for a hot drink [E].
en: Fire lit. Warm up, dry off, and melt snow for a hot drink [E].
zh: 火生起来了。烤暖、烘干，再融雪烧点热水 [E]。

keys: No dry wood left to add.
en: No dry wood left to add.

keys: Added a log (+%d min of fire).
en: Added a log (+%d min of fire).
zh: 添了一根柴（火多烧 %d 分钟）。

keys: Getting cold — get out of the wind or light a fire.
en: Getting cold — get out of the wind or light a fire.
zh: 越来越冷——躲开风口，或者生火。

keys: Sun is down. Finish up, or sleep now [N].
en: Sun is down. Finish up, or sleep now [N].
zh: 太阳落山了。抓紧收尾，或者现在睡下 [N]。

keys: Long shadows — night is close. Rest when ready [N].
en: Long shadows — night is close. Rest when ready [N].
zh: 影子很长——快天黑了。准备好就休息 [N]。

keys: Very long shadows: <%d min of light. Finish now!
en: Very long shadows: <%d min of light. Finish now!
zh: 影子极长：天光不足 %d 分钟。马上完工！

keys: Shadows lengthening — ~%d min of light left.
en: Shadows lengthening — ~%d min of light left.
zh: 影子在变长——大约还有 %d 分钟天光。
太阳高度 %d°——越近傍晚影子越长。

keys: Snow is falling — hold [E] at your shelter: stick in the vent (1 wood).
en: Snow is falling — hold [E] at your shelter: stick in the vent (1 wood).
zh: 下雪了——在庇护所按住 [E]：往通风孔插根木棍（1 木）。

keys: Shelter done. Stockpile dry wood for the fire, then rest [N].
en: Shelter done. Stockpile dry wood for the fire, then rest [N].
zh: 庇护所完工。给火备足干柴，然后休息 [N]。

keys: Shelter done. Warm up by a fire [F] + hot drink, then rest [N].
en: Shelter done. Warm up by a fire [F] + hot drink, then rest [N].
zh: 庇护所完工。生火暖身 [F]、喝口热水，然后休息 [N]。

keys: Gather %s — then hold [E] at your site.
en: Gather %s — then hold [E] at your site.
zh: 先收集 %s——然后在工地按住 [E]。

keys: Lean-to: the reflector fire burns your stockpiled wood all night (%.0f h per log).
en: Lean-to: the reflector fire burns your stockpiled wood all night (%.0f h per log).
zh: 倒棚：反射火整夜烧你的备柴（每根 %.0f 小时）。
2 根通风管（空气更好，稍冷）

keys: Too close to the edge of the valley.
en: Too close to the edge of the valley.

keys: Allowed, but a lean-to without a rootball windbreak is cold. Snow here is deep enough for a snow shelter.
en: Allowed, but a lean-to without a rootball windbreak is cold. Snow here is deep enough for a snow shelter.
zh: 可以，但没有树根挡风的倒棚很冷。这里的雪够深，可以挖雪庇护所。

keys: Entrance faces INTO the wind (%d°) — expect drafts. [R] rotate
en: Entrance faces INTO the wind (%d°) — expect drafts. [R] rotate
zh: 入口正对风口（%d°）——会灌风。[R] 旋转

keys: Entrance is side-on to the wind (%d°)
en: Entrance is side-on to the wind (%d°)

keys: [Tab] shelter type   [R] rotate entrance   [T] roof   [2] vents   [E] place   [B] cancel
en: [Tab] shelter type   [R] rotate entrance   [T] roof   [2] vents   [E] place   [B] cancel
zh: [Tab] 类型   [R] 旋转入口   [T] 顶厚   [2] 通风管   [E] 放置   [B] 取消

keys: You're already building a %s. Hold [E] at the site to continue.
en: You're already building a %s. Hold [E] at the site to continue.
zh: 你已经在建 %s 了。到工地按住 [E] 继续。

keys: Site marked. Hold [E] at the site to work: %s
en: Site marked. Hold [E] at the site to work: %s
zh: 工地已标好。按住 [E] 施工：%s

keys: Push a stick through the vent (1 wood) — keeps it clear in falling snow
en: Push a stick through the vent (1 wood) — keeps it clear in falling snow

en: No fire inside a snow shelter, and one outside doesn't reach you while you sleep.
zh: 雪庇护所里不能生火；外面的火在你睡着时也够不着你。

keys: A fire beside it helps a little.
en: A fire beside it helps a little.

keys: From stage 4 its back wall reflects the fire's heat onto you: the warmest fire you can have.
en: From stage 4 its back wall reflects the fire's heat onto you: the warmest fire you can have.
zh: 第 4 阶起，后墙把火的热量反射到你身上：能有的最暖的火。

keys: From stage 2 the rock reflects the fire's heat onto you.
en: From stage 2 the rock reflects the fire's heat onto you.
zh: 第 2 阶起，岩壁把火的热量反射到你身上。

keys: A fire in front helps; there is no wall to reflect it.
en: A fire in front helps; there is no wall to reflect it.
zh: 前面生火有帮助；没有墙把热量反射回来。

keys: Dug sideways into a deep drift on a slope, with the sleeping bench above the entrance so the warm air stays in. The warmest shelter, if you find snow deep enough.
en: Dug sideways into a deep drift on a slope, with the sleeping bench above the entrance so the warm air stays in. The warmest shelter, if you find snow deep enough.
zh: 在坡上的深雪堆里横着挖进去，睡台高过入口，暖空气留在里面。找得到够深的雪，这是最暖的庇护所。

keys: A quicker snow cave with a level sleeping floor. No raised platform or cold-air sump: colder than a raised cave even when fully built.
en: A quicker snow cave with a level sleeping floor. No raised platform or cold-air sump: colder than a raised cave even when fully built.
zh: 施工较快的基础雪洞，睡面与入口通道同高。没有高床和冷气槽：即使全部完工，也比高床雪洞冷。

keys: A trench dug into flat snow and roofed over. Works where the snow is too thin for a cave, but it is colder.
en: A trench dug into flat snow and roofed over. Works where the snow is too thin for a cave, but it is colder.
zh: 在平地的雪里挖一条沟，再盖上顶。雪太薄挖不了洞时能用，但更冷。

keys: A sloped roof of branches with a fire in front. Best with a rootball at its back; for thin snow and plenty of wood.
en: A sloped roof of branches with a fire in front. Best with a rootball at its back; for thin snow and plenty of wood.
zh: 树枝搭的斜顶，前面生火。最好背靠树根盘；适合雪薄、柴多的地方。

keys: The hollow under an old spruce's low branches, dug out and roofed. Quick, and the branches keep the snow off.
en: The hollow under an old spruce's low branches, dug out and roofed. Quick, and the branches keep the snow off.
zh: 老云杉低垂的枝条下面的雪坑，掏空再盖顶。快，枝条还能挡雪。

keys: A heap of snow piled up, left to settle, then hollowed out. Works on flat ground with shallow snow; takes long.
en: A heap of snow piled up, left to settle, then hollowed out. Works on flat ground with shallow snow; takes long.
zh: 把雪堆成一堆，等它凝实，再掏空。平地、雪浅也能做；很费时间。

keys: The lee side of a tall rock or the foot of a cliff, walled in with branches. Dry and out of the wind; cold rock underneath, so pile on bedding.
en: The lee side of a tall rock or the foot of a cliff, walled in with branches. Dry and out of the wind; cold rock underneath, so pile on bedding.
zh: 高岩石的背风面或悬崖脚，用树枝围起来。干燥、避风；身下的岩石很冷，要铺厚垫层。

keys: Branches leaned against a fallen trunk lying in the snow. Fast to build; works like a small lean-to.
en: Branches leaned against a fallen trunk lying in the snow. Fast to build; works like a small lean-to.
zh: 把树枝斜靠在雪里的倒木上。搭得快，像个小倒棚。

keys: Fire watch on: you'll wake when the fire burns low.
en: Fire watch on: you'll wake when the fire burns low.
zh: 守火已开：火快烧完时你会醒来添柴。

keys: Fire watch off: a low fire will not wake you just for refuelling.
en: Fire watch off: a low fire will not wake you just for refuelling.
zh: 守火已关：不会仅因需要添柴而叫醒你。

keys: Fire watch: the fire is low
en: Fire watch: the fire is low

keys: Body warmth %d. Awake by choice, before the cold wakes you: tend the fire or warm up, then sleep again. Every wake costs sleep.
en: Body warmth %d. Awake by choice, before the cold wakes you: tend the fire or warm up, then sleep again. Every wake costs sleep.
zh: 保暖值 %d。趁还没被冻醒，自己先醒：照看火、活动取暖，然后接着睡。每次醒来都要花掉睡眠。

keys: Body warmth %d. You woke as planned, while still warm — feed it now and it keeps you warm.
en: Body warmth %d. You woke as planned, while still warm — feed it now and it keeps you warm.
zh: 保暖值 %d。按约好的醒了，人还暖和——现在添柴，火就能接着护着你。

keys: Night score %d / 100   ·   warmth %d  ·  sleep %d  ·  health %d   ·   slept about %.1f h
en: Night score %d / 100   ·   warmth %d  ·  sleep %d  ·  health %d   ·   slept about %.1f h
zh: 夜晚得分 %d / 100   ·   保暖值 %d  ·  睡眠 %d  ·  健康 %d   ·   约睡了 %.1f 小时

keys: The roof sags under new snow
en: The roof sags under new snow

keys: Body warmth %d. The cold woke you — do something, or try to sleep on.
en: Body warmth %d. The cold woke you — do something, or try to sleep on.
zh: 保暖值 %d。冷把你冻醒了——做点什么，或者接着睡。

keys: Body warmth %d. You are dangerously cold. Move in your bedding or use an available heat source.
en: Body warmth %d. You are dangerously cold. Move in your bedding or use an available heat source.
zh: 保暖值 %d。你已严重失温。请在铺位活动，或利用可用热源取暖。

keys: The fire is low. Add fuel if you need its heat; the remaining burn time depends on the weather.
en: The fire is low. Add fuel if you need its heat; the remaining burn time depends on the weather.
zh: 火快烧完了。如果还需要它供暖，请添柴；剩余燃烧时间受天气影响。

keys: You went to bed in wet socks. Wet layers insulate less effectively.
en: You went to bed in wet socks. Wet layers insulate less effectively.
zh: 你穿着湿袜子睡下了。湿衣物的保温效果会降低。

keys: There is no open vent. Clear an air passage before going back to sleep.
en: There is no open vent. Clear an air passage before going back to sleep.
zh: 通气孔不通。请先打通换气通道，再继续睡。

keys: New snow has buried the vent. The air is getting thick.
en: New snow has buried the vent. The air is getting thick.
zh: 新雪把通风口埋住了，空气越来越闷。

keys: Snow is piling on the boughs above you. If it caves in, the cold gets in.
en: Snow is piling on the boughs above you. If it caves in, the cold gets in.
zh: 雪在头顶的枝条上越堆越厚。塌下来，冷就进来了。

keys: Add wood to the fire (%d logs left)
en: Add wood to the fire (%d logs left)
zh: 往火里添柴（还剩 %d 根）

keys: Get up and move (+%d warmth, costs sleep)
en: Get up and move (+%d warmth, costs sleep)
zh: 起来活动（保暖值 +%d，少睡一会儿）

keys: Knock the snow off the roof
en: Knock the snow off the roof

keys: Dry your socks and boots by the fire
en: Dry your socks and boots by the fire

keys: Your night: you slept through until dawn.
en: Your night: you slept through until dawn.
zh: 你的夜晚：一觉睡到天亮。

keys: You made it to dawn in good condition. Lowest body warmth %d.
en: You made it to dawn in good condition. Lowest body warmth %d.
zh: 你状态良好地熬到了天亮。最低保暖值 %d。

keys: You made it to dawn, but it was a hard night: lowest body warmth %d, woke once. Biggest heat leak: %s.
en: You made it to dawn, but it was a hard night: lowest body warmth %d, woke once. Biggest heat leak: %s.
zh: 你熬到了天亮，但这一夜很难熬：保暖值最低 %d，醒了 1 次。热量漏得最多的是：%s。

keys: You made it to dawn, but it was a hard night: lowest body warmth %d, woke %d times. Biggest heat leak: %s.
en: You made it to dawn, but it was a hard night: lowest body warmth %d, woke %d times. Biggest heat leak: %s.
zh: 你熬到了天亮，但这一夜很难熬：保暖值最低 %d，醒了 %d 次。热量漏得最多的是：%s。

keys: The air ran out in a shelter with no vent. You woke with the warning and went back to sleep.
en: The air ran out in a shelter with no vent. You woke with the warning and went back to sleep.
zh: 没有通风口的庇护所里空气耗尽了。你醒来时已经有了警告，却又睡了回去。

keys: Your body warmth fell to %d — severe hypothermia. Biggest heat leak: %s.
en: Your body warmth fell to %d — severe hypothermia. Biggest heat leak: %s.
zh: 你的保暖值跌到了 %d——严重失温。热量漏得最多的是：%s。

keys: You took on %s at the same time. "Cold, the ground, or hunger — only one of those at a time."
en: You took on %s at the same time. "Cold, the ground, or hunger — only one of those at a time."
zh: 你同时承受了 %s。"冷、睡地上、挨饿——一次只能受一样。"

keys: Wet kit and no drying fire during sleep — cold, damp boots made the night harder.
en: Wet kit and no drying fire during sleep — cold, damp boots made the night harder.
zh: 装备受潮，睡眠期间又没有火源烘干——湿冷的靴子让这一夜更难熬。

keys: You kept the fire going until dawn.
en: You kept the fire going until dawn.
zh: 你把火一直烧到了天亮。

keys: The fire last went out at %s. Its heating effect ended then.
en: The fire last went out at %s. Its heating effect ended then.
zh: 火最后在 %s 熄灭，此后不再提供热量。

keys: Read the land: trees lean away from the wind, snow piles up on leeward slopes, standing dead trees are dry fuel —
en: Read the land: trees lean away from the wind, snow piles up on leeward slopes, standing dead trees are dry fuel —
zh: 读懂大地：树冠背风倾斜，背风坡积雪最深，立枯木是干柴——

keys: and the shadows tell you how much daylight is left.
en: and the shadows tell you how much daylight is left.
zh: 影子告诉你还剩多少天光。

en: [2]  Full day — start at 10:00 (more time, watch the shadows shorten and grow)
zh: [2]  全天模式——10:00 开局（时间更宽裕，看影子先变短再变长）

keys: Trees show wind direction — branches are short on the windward side, crowns lean downwind.
en: Trees show wind direction — branches are short on the windward side, crowns lean downwind.
zh: 树指示风向——迎风侧枝条短，树冠向下风倾斜。

keys: Snow drifts reveal depth — leeward slopes collect the deepest snow. Probe to be sure.
en: Snow drifts reveal depth — leeward slopes collect the deepest snow. Probe to be sure.
zh: 积雪形状透露深度——背风坡雪最深。用探针确认。

keys: Standing dead trees mean fuel — fallen logs are wet and won't burn.
en: Standing dead trees mean fuel — fallen logs are wet and won't burn.
zh: 立枯木是燃料——倒木是湿的，烧不着。

keys: Rootballs and thick forest break the wind — shelter there, and light fires there.
en: Rootballs and thick forest break the wind — shelter there, and light fires there.
zh: 树根盘和密林能挡风——在那里避风、生火。

keys: Shadows tell time — the longer they get, the less daylight you have left.
en: Shadows tell time — the longer they get, the less daylight you have left.
zh: 影子就是时钟——影子越长，天光越少。

keys: Birch bark — tinder (white trunk, black bands)
en: Birch bark — tinder (white trunk, black bands)
zh: 桦树皮——引火物（白树干、黑横纹）

keys: Snow — melt it over a fire for a hot drink
en: Snow — melt it over a fire for a hot drink
zh: 雪——在火上融化，烧热水喝
[Esc] 继续      [R] 重开      [Q] 退出      [C] 致谢与许可

keys: Snow Shelter Challenge — design and development by the Winter Shelter project.
en: Snow Shelter Challenge — design and development by the Winter Shelter project.
zh: 雪夜庇护——Winter Shelter 项目设计与开发。

keys: Built with the Godot Engine (godotengine.org). Character modelled procedurally in Blender.
en: Built with the Godot Engine (godotengine.org). Character modelled procedurally in Blender.
zh: 使用 Godot 引擎（godotengine.org）制作；角色用 Blender 程序化建模。

en: Chinese text fallback font: Droid Sans Fallback © Google, Apache License 2.0 (assets/fonts/DroidSansFallback-LICENSE.txt).
zh: 中文后备字体：Droid Sans Fallback © Google，Apache License 2.0（assets/fonts/DroidSansFallback-LICENSE.txt）。

en: All other art, sound and shaders are generated procedurally by this project.

keys: Survival starts with understanding.          [R] try again
en: Survival starts with understanding.          [R] try again
zh: 生存始于理解。          [R] 再来一次

keys: You slept through the night and walked out at dawn. Weakest point: %s.
en: You slept through the night and walked out at dawn. Weakest point: %s.
zh: 你睡了一整夜，天亮时走了出来。最弱的一环：%s。

keys: You made it to dawn, shivering. Weakest point: %s.
en: You made it to dawn, shivering. Weakest point: %s.
zh: 你哆嗦着熬到了天亮。最弱的一环：%s。

keys: You would not have survived this night. Main cause: %s.
en: You would not have survived this night. Main cause: %s.
zh: 这一夜你撑不过去。主要原因：%s。

keys: Face the entrance away from the wind — the trees lean downwind and the compass needle shows where the wind goes.
en: Face the entrance away from the wind — the trees lean downwind and the compass needle shows where the wind goes.
zh: 入口要背对风——树冠向下风倾斜，罗盘指针指向风的去向。

keys: Start digging earlier. When the shadows grow long, you have less than an hour of light.
en: Start digging earlier. When the shadows grow long, you have less than an hour of light.
zh: 早点开工。影子变长时，天光已不到一小时。

keys: Gather bedding: dry grass and low spruce boughs keep the snow from stealing your heat.
en: Gather bedding: dry grass and low spruce boughs keep the snow from stealing your heat.
zh: 收集垫层：干草和云杉低枝能挡住雪吸走你的热量。

keys: Keep the sleeping platform above the low entrance passage. Choose a raised cave when snow depth and time allow; bedding reduces heat loss to snow.
en: Keep the sleeping platform above the low entrance passage. Choose a raised cave when snow depth and time allow; bedding reduces heat loss to snow.
zh: 让睡台高于低位入口通道。雪深和时间允许时选高床雪洞；铺厚垫层可减少向雪面的散热。

keys: Keep an air vent open in an enclosed snow shelter. Check it after snowfall.
en: Keep an air vent open in an enclosed snow shelter. Check it after snowfall.
zh: 封闭雪屋要保持通气孔畅通，降雪后注意检查。

keys: Probe several spots — deeper snow means thicker walls. Warm up by a fire and drink something hot before you crawl in.
en: Probe several spots — deeper snow means thicker walls. Warm up by a fire and drink something hot before you crawl in.
zh: 多探几处——雪越深墙越厚。钻进去前先烤火、喝点热的。

keys: An open lean-to loses heat to the outside air. Use thick bedding and tend the fire, or choose a cave where snow is deep enough.
en: An open lean-to loses heat to the outside air. Use thick bedding and tend the fire, or choose a cave where snow is deep enough.
zh: 开放式斜棚容易向外界散热。铺厚垫层、照料火堆，或在雪深足够处选建雪洞。

keys: The night is %.0f hours long. At %.0f h per log, a lean-to fire needs about %d logs of dry wood stockpiled.
en: The night is %.0f hours long. At %.0f h per log, a lean-to fire needs about %d logs of dry wood stockpiled.
zh: 夜长 %.0f 小时。每根柴烧 %.0f 小时，倒棚的火需要备约 %d 根干柴。

keys: When snow is falling, leave a stick in the vent and poke it clear — or dig a second vent.
en: When snow is falling, leave a stick in the vent and poke it clear — or dig a second vent.
zh: 下雪时在通风孔里插根木棍，夜里捅开——或者再挖一根通风管。

keys: Without any shelter the wind takes your heat all night. Even a half-finished trench is better than nothing.
en: Without any shelter the wind takes your heat all night. Even a half-finished trench is better than nothing.
zh: 没有庇护所，风会整夜带走你的热量。哪怕半成品的雪沟也比什么都没有强。

keys: Survive a night in a shelter and you've learned it — use it on any level after that.
en: Survive a night in a shelter and you've learned it — use it on any level after that.
zh: 在某种庇护所里熬过一夜，就算学会了——之后任何关卡都能用。

en: %s  ·  %d °C  ·  wind from the %s, %d km/h  ·  sunset %s, ~%d h of light

keys: A shovel digs at full speed. Digging still makes you sweat — dry off by a fire before bed.
en: A shovel digs at full speed. Digging still makes you sweat — dry off by a fire before bed.
zh: 有雪铲，挖雪是全速。挖雪照样出汗——睡前在火边烘干。

keys: Without a shovel every snow shelter takes much longer — a trench or a tree well may be all the day allows.
en: Without a shovel every snow shelter takes much longer — a trench or a tree well may be all the day allows.
zh: 没有雪铲，每种雪庇护所都慢得多——这一天也许只够做雪沟或树井。

keys: All shelters are open in free play.
en: All shelters are open in free play.
zh: 自由模式里所有庇护所都可用。

keys: [N] on this screen gives the same stage a new map.
en: [N] on this screen gives the same stage a new map.
zh: 在这一页按 [N]：同一阶换一张新图。

en: 2. Raise the bed: find deeper snow and build a raised cave. Keep the sleeping platform above the entrance passage; the weather is as gentle as in stage 1.
zh: 2. 把床抬高：寻找更深的雪，建高床雪洞，让睡台高于入口通道。天气与第一关一样温和，比较结构带来的差别。

keys: 3. Prepare for the night: choose your cave, dry your clothes and check the vent and bedding. Wake and get up when needed. Survive to open chapter 2.
en: 3. Prepare for the night: choose your cave, dry your clothes and check the vent and bedding. Wake and get up when needed. Survive to open chapter 2.
zh: 3. 独立过夜：选择雪洞，烘干衣物，检查通风和垫层；必要时夜里起床处理。熬过这一夜就开放第二章。
